name: Technical Sergeant chevron, 4 in
size_citation: CAPR 39-1 (3 March 2020) Figure A5-4: "Chevrons are available in 3 1/2 and 4 inch sizes"; width = nominal chevron size, height from the figure proportion

mounts.uniform: Class A service dress coat (men's and women's, old and new style)
mounts.rule: 4 in chevron, centered on the outer arm halfway between the shoulder seam and the elbow bent at 90 degrees (4.1.5.2.1.2); NCOs wear the coat without epaulets

mounts.uniform: Class B blue shirt / blouse, lightweight blue jacket, topcoat, service coat of 4.1.9
mounts.rule: 3 1/2 or 4 in chevron, centered on the outer arm halfway between the shoulder seam and the elbow bent at 90 degrees; short-sleeved shirt: centered on the bottom edge of the sleeve; shoulder mark insignia not authorized (4.1.6.1.3, 4.1.9.3.3, 4.1.9.5.4, 6.1.3.3, 6.1.11.3.1)

mounts.uniform: ABU / BDU / blue field uniform coat
mounts.rule: 4 or 3 1/2 in, full color silver on dark blue, centered on the outer arm halfway between the shoulder seam and the elbow bent at 90 degrees; need not be fully visible if sleeves are rolled (5.1.1.1.1.2, 5.1.2.2.3, 5.2.1.1.1.3)
white chevron, use rank-senior-<grade>-chevron-white-4in (men 4 in, women 3 1/2 or 4 in; 4.1.1.1.1.4, 4.1.2.1.1.4); this navy chevron is not worn on the mess dress
grade device in metal on dark blue material (6.1.10.2.1, 6.1.14.4.1); use the ocp-square form where a 2 in square is required (7.1.1.2.1)

traced_from.method: 4x bicubic upsample, 3-class k-means, marching squares, RDP+Chaikin
